english: Whew... this world is pretty chaotic, huh.
Honestly... how long\ndo I have to keep this up, I wonder...
Miii, I'm all worn outt...
Now now, Rika, pull yourself together, please.
Everyone, you all look beat, desuuu...\nAre you okay, desuuu?
I'm not young anymoree...
(I mean, I HAVE lived a really long time...)
N-nyo!?
(What does Rika-san mean by 'not young', desuuu?)
H-ha ha...\nOf all people, Rika-chan says THAT...
Oh my, Remu-san - is that a wry smile?
N-n-nothing, really!\nBut, well, compared to Rika-chan, I mean...
...I've been waiting for Mama so long,\nso many days and months have slipped by...
Miii, Remu-san and Yase-san\nare still plenty youngg.
Indeed, the both of you are being so slovenly!
Of course I'm still young!\nRight, Yase-san?
Hmph.\nDon't lump me in\nwith you people...
Whoooa...
(Everyone... just how old ARE you all, desuuu?\nI'm scared to hear the truth, desuuu...)
...What is it?
N-no! It's nothing, desuuu...
Really? Well, if you say so...
Think something like that again and I won't go easy on you.
Y-yes!?
(H-how did she figure out what I was thinking, desuu!?)
...It was written all over your face:\n'Just how old ARE you, desuuu?'\n...
It was super obviouss.
Indeed.\nYou'd best be more careful from now on.
I-I'm sorry, desuuu...
(There really does seem to be some secret, desuuu...)
(Maybe they drank mermaid blood...\nor bathed in dragon's blood...)
Hehe, nothing like that!\nA proper routine and good sleep - that's what matters!
Y-yes, desuuu!
(D-don't think about it, desuuu!)
